dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Can I try the black ones?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! kən aɪ ˈtraɪ ðə ˈblæk wʌnz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Which ones? The tall ones or the short ones?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɪtʃ wʌnz? ðə ˈtɔːl wʌnz ɔːr ðə ˈʃɔːrt wʌnz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The short ones, please. Size thirty-eight.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈʃɔːrt wʌnz, ˈpliːz. ˈsaɪz ˌθɜːrti ˈeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They're nice, but it's too hot for boots! Do you have sandals?
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈnaɪs, bʌt ɪts ˈtuː ˈhɑːt fər ˈbuːts! duː juː ˈhæv ˈsændəlz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. These brown ones are a new style.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðiːz ˈbraʊn wʌnz ər ə ˈnuː ˈstaɪl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I love them! I'll take one pair, please.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ðɛm! aɪl ˈteɪk ˈwʌn ˈpɛr, ˈpliːz.
